newsitem.title: USA: Perkins says received offer of $13/unit.
newsitem.headline: Perkins says received offer of $13/unit.

text.p: Perkins Family Restaurants LP said its minority owner Restaurant Co offered to buy the remaining 52 percent of Perkins stock for $13.00 per unit.
Perkins said the Restaurant Co owns Perkins Management Co, the general partner of Perkins Family Restaurants, and owns 48 percent of the outstanding units of the limited partnership interest.
It added the proposed deal is subject to an opinion of fairness from an investment banking firm and unitholders' approval.
Trading in Perkins' stock was halted Monday afternoon, with the last sale at 10-15/16.
Perkins owns and operates 134 Perkins Family Restaurants and franchises an additional 332 restaurants in 32 states and Canada.
Perkins posted net income of $3.5 million, or $0.33 per unit, in the second quarter, compared with a $3.4 million net, or $0.32 per unit, the year before.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
